learning_objective: 🎯 Today we become Story Detectives! We will learn how to read carefully and find hidden answers.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When you get a short story to read, read it slowly two times. This helps your brain take a picture of what is happening!
Read the questions at the bottom. Are they asking Who, What, Where, or Why? Look back at the story and hunt for those exact words like a detective.
When you find the answer, do not just write one word! Write a beautiful, full sentence starting with a capital letter and ending with a full stop.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Be the Teacher!
fun_activity.instructions: Read a very short bedtime story. Now, pretend you are the teacher and ask your parent three questions about the story to see if they were listening!

quick_recap: ⭐ Comprehension means understanding what you read.
⭐ Always read the passage twice before answering.
⭐ Hunt for clues using question words like who, where, and what.
⭐ Write your answers in full, complete sentences.
